draft_text: Thornbill-NER appears somewhat robust to label noise in its training annotations.
revised_text: Thornbill-NER appears somewhat robust to label noise in its training annotations.
rationale: T2 shows Thornbill-NER drops of 0.6, 1.3, 1.8 points at 10/20/30% noise, all within the 2.0-point robustness criterion. The hedged "appears somewhat robust" matches this support. No statistical tests reported, so the hedge is appropriate.
